chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from Sa'd ibn Sa'd from Idris ibn Abdillah who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a newborn who is born and then dies on the seventh day, is an 'aqiqah sacrificed for him? He said: 'If he died before the midday prayer, no 'aqiqah is sacrificed for him, and if he died after the midday prayer, an 'aqiqah is sacrificed for him.'
ai.seo_question: When is the 'aqiqah sacrifice required for a newborn who dies in infancy?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) delineates the precise temporal boundary for the obligation of 'aqiqah, distinguishing between pre- and post-Dhuhr death on the seventh day. This ruling reflects the juristic principle that the 'aqiqah is tied to the completion of the seventh day, serving as a rite of gratitude and naming that becomes obligatory only once the child has survived this initial period. It highlights the meticulous attention to time in Shia fiqh regarding rites of passage for infants.
